summary: This Form 424B5 is a prospectus supplement for a takedown under an existing shelf registration (S-3) by IDEAYA Biosciences, Inc., an issuer. The filing covers a public offering of 5,555,556 shares of common stock and pre-funded warrants for 5,555,576 shares at a public offering price of $27.00 per share (pre-funded warrant price $26.9999), with gross proceeds of approximately $300 million. Underwriters include J.P. Morgan, Jefferies, and others. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. The only special-situations filing would be if this were a rights offering or other non-routine distribution; here it is a standard marketed follow-on offering for general corporate purposes.
